channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: 500 price checks at French petrol stations over claims of 'excessive' hikes
item.description: French prime minister Sébastien Lecornu has announced 500 spot checks at fuel stations across France, over fears of excessive price hikes in the wake of the war in Iran and the Gulf.

item.title: IN PICTURES: Thousands march in Women's Day demos across France
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of people marched in demos across France on Sunday marking International Women's Day, with Gisèle Pelicot leading the march in Paris.

item.title: Why are French demo turnout numbers always so different - and who is right?
item.description: Every time protesters take to the streets in France, there is a huge gap in estimated turnout depending on who you believe - authorities or organisers. Here's a look at why, and who is counting correctly.

item.title: Paris mayor: Right-wing candidate's programme for a 'more secure' city
item.description: Two frontrunners have emerged in the race for Paris' new mayor - Anne Hidalgo’s former deputy mayor Emmanuel Grégoire and Rachida Dati - a leading right-wing figure. Here's Dati's vision for the French capital.

item.title: Paris mayor: Left-wing candidate's plan for a 'city Parisians can breathe in'
item.description: As the race for Paris mayor heats up, here's a look at the programme of one of the front-runners - the left-wing candidate Emmanuel Grégoire.

item.title: French Expression of the Day: Être béton
item.description: This French expression is rock solid.

item.title: 'Everyone benefits' - Why Airbnb is welcomed in certain parts of France
item.description: Airbnb is controversial in large urban centres such as Paris or Nice, but in rural areas or small towns, locals say the platform can be a useful way to attract additional tourist revenue.

item.title: Explained: The crucial 'alliances' that shape French elections
item.description: It's hardly unusual for political parties to make deals and agreements with each other - but France's unique two-round voting system means that alliances will play a vital role in the 2026 local elections.

item.title: The essential vocab to understand France's upcoming local elections
item.description: France heads to the polls on Sunday, March 15th for the first round of the 2026 municipal elections - here are a few key words and phrases you will need to know.

item.title: French court rejects Sarkozy's bid to merge jail terms
item.description: A French court ruled on Monday that former president Nicolas Sarkozy must serve jail time for an illegal funding conviction, a source close to the case said, after his lawyer sought to merge sentences for two separate convictions.
